subject.title: fix: apply session visibility changes without restart

question: Should already-created Gateway session tools follow the newly published `tools.sessions.visibility` and `tools.agentToAgent` policy without a restart, while explicitly supplied per-run configs remain pinned?
rationale: This changes the timing of session-access authorization for live Gateway tool instances; the implementation is narrowly scoped, but the `maintainer` label requires an explicit owner decision on that runtime contract.

options.title: Accept live policy updates
options.body: Merge the late-binding behavior so the no-restart configuration result immediately matches session-tool authorization.

options.title: Keep construction-time policy
options.body: Retain the existing restart-required behavior and update the reload planner or operator messaging to state that session tools are not hot-reloaded.

recommendation.title: Accept live policy updates
recommendation.body: Merge the late-binding behavior so the no-restart configuration result immediately matches session-tool authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR evidence connects this person to the runtime reload investigation and the proposed boundary between Gateway-owned and explicitly supplied configs.
